# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 5 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Charts — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 46 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Duration — 6 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens; Layout — 8 tokens; Z index — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #141729);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #141729;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #141729 | #ffffff | Cards, sidebar, tab bar and top bars. The default ground for text. |
| `--surface-raised` | #1b1f35 | #ffffff | Toasts, menus, bottom sheets, popovers and the mini-player: anything floating above a card. Pair with a shadow token. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #090b14 | #eceae4 | Gauge and progress tracks, segmented-control wells, code and pairing-code boxes. Never put body text on it at less than 13px. |
| `--surface-inverse` | #eef0f8 | #1f2233 | Chart tooltips only. A small, high-contrast flag that floats over data. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | dark | light |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | #20243c | #f0efea |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 72px/72px "Geist", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-num-gauge); letter-spacing: -0.04em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `num-gauge` | `.num-gauge`, `--text-num-gauge` | 72px / 72px, letter-spacing -0.04em | 600 | `sans` | The load number inside the hero gauge (desktop 280px gauge). 56px on mobile. Always tabular numerals. |
| `num-timer` | `.num-timer`, `--text-num-timer` | 64px / 64px, letter-spacing -0.03em | 500 | `sans` | Pomodoro and focus countdown. 56px on mobile. Tabular numerals so digits never shift. |
| `num-stat` | `.num-stat`, `--text-num-stat` | 28px / 34px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Stat tiles and KPI values. |
| `num-inline` | `.num-inline`, `--text-num-inline` | 15px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Percentages in breakdown rows, durations in task rows, playback time. |
| `title-1` | `.title-1`, `--text-title-1` | 28px / 34px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Page title in the desktop top bar; auth and onboarding headings. |
| `title-2` | `.title-2`, `--text-title-2` | 20px / 28px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | Mobile top-bar title, hero context name, sheet titles. |
| `title-3` | `.title-3`, `--text-title-3` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Card titles, empty-state titles, toast titles. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 17px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Hero explanations, onboarding copy, break-screen prompts. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI text. 16px minimum inside inputs on mobile (prevents zoom). |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Reasons, helper text, breakdown explanations, table cells. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Buttons, nav items, field labels, chips. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `sans` | Timestamps, axis ticks, tab-bar labels (12px is the floor). |
| `overline` | `.overline`, `--text-overline` | 11px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.08em | 600 | `sans` | Section eyebrows above card groups. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS; never use for sentences. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 20px / 28px, letter-spacing 0.12em | 500 | `mono` | Pairing codes on source cards and the VS Code status-bar text spec. |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap inside chips and pills. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between an icon and its text; between stacked label and value. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap between list rows and between chips. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding on mobile; mobile page gutter; gap between cards on mobile. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Card padding on desktop. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Grid gutter on desktop and tablet; gap between cards. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Desktop page padding (top and sides); space between page sections. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Space above a page title; onboarding step padding. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Empty-state vertical padding. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Auth and onboarding panel padding on desktop. |

## Duration

Motion durations. Under prefers-reduced-motion every one of these becomes 1ms except dur-gauge, which drops to 0 (values jump) and the breathing animation, which stops.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--dur-instant: 80ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--dur-instant), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dur-instant` | 80ms | Press feedback, toggle thumb colour. |
| `--dur-fast` | 140ms | Hover fills, focus ring, chip selection. |
| `--dur-base` | 240ms | Toasts in and out, sheet content fade, banner swap. |
| `--dur-slow` | 400ms | Context colour crossfade, task reorder (FLIP), sheet slide. |
| `--dur-gauge` | 600ms | Gauge arc and number tween. Shorter than the 2s update interval, so each tick settles before the next. |
| `--dur-breath` | 8000ms | One full breathing cycle on break screens (4s in, 4s out). |
